title: Model-evaluation fixture
description: One hand-authored NL-to-query fixture for the Arranger query-generation evaluation. The unit under evaluation is the generated query (SQON filter + GraphQL field selection + optional aggregation), scored against the reference query held here. This schema describes the canonical fixture OBJECT, which the harness reads as one record per line of JSONL. The companion fixtures.csv is the flat authoring/overview serialization of this same object: one row per fixture, with the CSV serialization rules below.
$comment: CSV serialization (fixtures.csv): one column per top-level property, in the order listed in `properties`. Scalars are written as-is. Booleans (requires_aggregation, feasible) are written as the literal strings `yes`/`no`. Tri-state validation fields (reference_validated, frontier_pass) are written `yes`/`no`/`pending`. Object and array properties (catalogues, reference_sqon, reference_ast, reference_fields, reference_aggregation, expected_record_ids) are written as compact JSON strings; a present-but-empty array is `[]`. A null value is an empty cell. CSV cells are quoted per RFC 4180 (cells containing commas, quotes, or newlines are double-quoted, internal quotes doubled). This file is the source of truth for structure; the SQON dialect itself (operators, value typing) is validated by the harness's Zod schema, not here.

id.description: Unique fixture id. Convention: {filter_complexity}-{schema_reach}-{NNN}, e.g. boolean-deep-001. Stable for the life of the fixture.

source.description: Origin of the fixture. Synthetic fixtures are hand-authored; captured-user fixtures are real prompts promoted from user testing after the governance/redaction review.

corpus.description: Which corpus the fixture belongs to. `main` holds the 50 feasible + 8 negative fixtures that produce the ranking; `adversarial` holds the optional hostile-prompt set scored on refusal rate, tagged distinctly so it never enters the EA ranking.

fixture_set_version.description: Semantic version of the fixture corpus this fixture was authored into, e.g. 5.0.0.

introspection_commit.description: Commit hash of the frozen Arranger introspection snapshot this fixture is authored against. Every field referenced in the reference query must exist in this snapshot.

index_commit.description: Commit/version identifier of the index state used for offline validation. Provenance only; not on the per-run scoring path.

author.description: Who authored the fixture (initials or name). Optional but recommended for the captured-prompt promotion loop.

date_authored.description: ISO date the fixture was authored or last revised.

filter_complexity.description: Difficulty axis 1: the SQON operation. single-predicate = one field/op; boolean = AND/OR over multiple predicates; negation = NOT / not-in / some-not-in. Drives the per-bucket quality gates.

schema_reach.description: Difficulty axis 2: how hard the field structure is to navigate. single-shallow = top-level field(s) in one catalogue; single-deep = nested field paths within one catalogue; cross-catalogue = fields spanning more than one catalogue. Reported as a diagnostic, not gated.

requires_aggregation.description: Whether the question implies a GraphQL aggregation. Orthogonal tag spread across the difficulty grid, not its own bucket. CSV: yes/no.

feasible.description: true = a valid query exists over the snapshot (scored on execution accuracy). false = negative/infeasible fixture referencing fields/values/relationships not in the snapshot; correct behavior is to decline, scored on the decline/flag rubric. CSV: yes/no.

catalogues.description: Catalogue(s) the query touches, e.g. ["file_centric"] or ["file_centric","argo_mock"]. Descriptive metadata; for cross-catalogue fixtures this lists every catalogue spanned.

negative_reason.description: Why an infeasible/adversarial fixture has no valid query. Required when feasible=false; null otherwise. Aligns with the failure taxonomy's hallucination / refusal modes.

prompt.description: The natural-language data-discovery question presented to the model.

reference_sqon.description: Ground-truth SQON filter (Overture op/content shape). Null for infeasible fixtures.

reference_ast.description: reference_sqon in canonical normal form (groups flattened, commutative operands sorted and deduped, negation canonicalized, value collections normalized). This is what filter-EA compares against. Null for infeasible fixtures.

reference_fields.description: Expected GraphQL field-selection set as field paths, e.g. ["donors.specimens.samples.sample_id","analysis.experiment"]. Compared as a set after sort/dedup (field-EA). Null/empty for infeasible fixtures.

reference_aggregation.description: Expected aggregation spec, or null when requires_aggregation is false.

expected_record_ids.description: Record ids returned when reference_sqon is executed against the index at authoring time. Validation/provenance artifact ONLY — never a scoring target. Empty until the validation pass runs; empty for infeasible fixtures.

reference_validated.description: Did the offline validation pass execute reference_sqon cleanly against the live index and populate expected_record_ids? pending = not yet run.

frontier_pass.description: Did the frontier model solve this fixture zero-shot in the offline sanity check? `no` flags the fixture for re-authoring review (ambiguous prompt or buggy reference). pending = sanity check not yet run. The frontier never enters candidate ranking.

frontier_model.description: Frontier model id used for the sanity check, e.g. claude-opus-4-7. Null until run.

validation_date.description: ISO date the validation/sanity-check passes were last run against this fixture.

notes.description: Free-text authoring notes: intent, edge cases, ambiguity resolved, links to the captured prompt it was promoted from.

sqonNode.description: A SQON node: either a group operator over child nodes, or a leaf predicate over a field. Structural shape only; the harness's Zod schema validates operator/value legality.

content.description: For group ops: an array of child SQON nodes. For leaf ops: an object with fieldName and value.

field.description: Field the aggregation runs over, e.g. donors__specimens__samples__sample_type.

aggType.description: Aggregation kind, e.g. terms, stats, numeric_range, missing, cardinality.

args.description: Aggregation arguments (e.g. ranges, size, interval). Canonicalized before comparison. Empty object when none.
